technical_requirements: Indexing scale: target corpus 120M documents (~25B tokens). Initial indexing run must complete within 72 hours on customer GFE cluster. Embeddings: 1024-d vectors, batched ingest 50k docs/hr during steady state; support reindex incremental updates. Reranking: candidate generation (approx top-200) then neural rerank top-20; p95 rerank latency target <= 50ms on dedicated GPU pool, end-to-end UI search SLO <= 200ms. Must support deterministic vectors across quantized model variants for auditability. KV/prefix cache required for chat-like flows. Storage encryption at rest, customer KMS/HSM integration required.

Procurement team requested a red-team statement and CVEs history. Expect 8-12 week procurement cycle after SOW finalization.
cost_targets: Target cost per user query (end-to-end) < $0.03 CPA equivalent at scale (expected 200k queries/mo steady state). Want dedicated pricing for on-prem license + year 1 support in ARR band $500k-$2M.
performance_targets: P95 latency goals: reranker <= 50ms, embedding lookup <= 30ms, full search UX <= 200ms. Throughput: support sustained 400 qps for retrieval pipeline across burst windows. Batch ingestion peak 1M docs/day during initial sync.
